JAK2-STAT5 signaling (Bachmann 2011)

Source: vignettes/articles/bachmannMSB2011.Rmd
bachmannMSB2011.Rmd

[1] TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE TRUE

Shows: eqnlist(), odemodel(), Y(), normL2(), constraintL2(), mstrust(), plotCombined(), importPEtab(), exportPEtab().

JAK2-STAT5 signaling in CFU-E cells with the feedbacks of CIS, SOCS3 and SHP1, after Bachmann et al. (2011), Mol Syst Biol 7:516. 541 measurements from 13 experiments in 36 conditions, 20 observables, 113 parameters, fitted within the bounds of the publication. petab.R imports the problem from the PEtab benchmark collection; the guide chapter PEtab shows import and export on the guide model.

Files

file content
model.R data, reactions, observables, error model, conditions, compiling, objective
fit.R multistart of 200 fits, saves results/fits.rds
plots.R figures from the saved results
petab.R the problem from the PEtab files, compared with model.R, and model.R written as PEtab
results/ saved fits, and in results/petab/ the problem petab.R writes

Run

With this folder as working directory:

source("model.R")     # compiles into build/
source("fit.R")
source("plots.R")

model.R uses the free cores of the machine. The guide chapter Remote computing shows how to run a multistart on other machines. plots.R fits nothing: it reads results/ and simulates the compiled model.

Fit

200 of 200 fits returned, 200 converged. The best value of -2 log L is -480.298, reached by 9 fits within 1. The published optimum has -480.298.
